draft.title: Untitled Position
draft.position_summary: Acts as the initial point of contact to support principal functional and technical support resource for all SFU telephone-related processes. Responds to inquiries from SFU telephone users, and provides direction and assistance on the use of telephones and features. Investigates telephone trouble reports. Consults with the phone user to provide an immediate resolution by resolving minor technical telephone system problems, or logs a trouble ticket through an SFU computer tracking system to generate a work order for an SFU phone technician or external contractor to resolve the problem. Prepares monthly billing reports for departmental telephone services. Investigates and resolves departmental enquiries related to telephone billing.

duties.statement: Orders, receives, distributes and re-bills for inventory and equipment to customers, as required
Prepares/rotates files for new fiscal year and archival storage
Trains new/relief Switchboard Operators in all job functions, as required

D) Updates the appropriate fields in the telephone billing system and marks as “pending”. Upon return of work orders from phone technicians, tests/checks the new/revised configurations to ensure they have been correctly implemented. Liaises with phone technicians and clients to ensure successful completion of work, and the closure of trouble tickets. Notifies the Administrator, Network Services of any outstanding issues or concerns. Finalizes updates in various information systems and ensures changes are accurate to support monthly billing cycles, directories, and other applications that self- update (eg., 911 notification system used by Campus Security)
Develops and documents procedures as protocols change, in consultation with supervisor

Forwards mapping of unique or large-scale telephone system configurations to the Administrator, Network Services for review and approval prior to inputting work orders. Ensures requests are made or approved by individuals with departmental signing authority. Ensures conformity with LD Telephone Charges policy (AD 1.05), Telephone Service policy (AD 1.15) and Telephone Services information contained in the SFU Campus Directory
Investigates and resolves departmental enquiries related to telephone- related billing, and adjusts billing as required in the next reporting period
Performs other related duties and responsibilities consistent with position classification upon request
Performs routine office procedures, as required
Receives name change requests via phone or e-mail (e.g. ticket), and assigns the work to the Switchboard Operator to update the switchboard/call display, directories and information systems

Extrapolates data from internal (change control software) and external sources (e.g., Telus invoices) using custom and “shrink wrapped” computer applications, to prepare monthly billing reports for departmental telephone services (e.g., calling cards, conference calls, connection charges, rental adjustments, etc.). Collates resulting reports and supporting documentation of charges and assigns responsibility to the Switchboard Operator for distribution to customers

Logs a summary of the work to be performed through ITS’ change control software to create a work order number and provide tracking ability for the work’s progress. Creates additional change control documentation through custom software to produce individual work orders generated for SFU phone technicians or external contractors (e.g. Mitel) for completion, and updates information in various directories. Itemizes services required, and lists the service requests in priority order, notifying phone technicians of urgent or rush orders. Advises Supervisor of any concerns regarding communications with phone technicians

external: List internal and external contacts (i.e., specific positions within own department, other departments, students, faculty, on/off campus vendors, etc.), the duration of each contact (i.e. less than 1 hour at a time, 1-2 hours at a time, more than 2 hours at a time), and the frequency of each contact (i.e. occasional, frequent, or continuous).

model.title: Telephone Services Coordinator
model.position_summary: The Telephone Services Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for all SFU telephone users, delivering functional and technical support, managing inventory, billing, and system configurations. This role ensures accurate billing cycles, maintains telephone equipment and records, trains and assigns work to switchboard operators, and coordinates with internal and external technicians to resolve issues promptly. The coordinator also develops procedures, ensures policy compliance, and performs routine administrative tasks while handling confidential information with discretion and high accuracy.
